stem.text: Two forces, each of magnitude $F$, act in opposite directions on a rod.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod with a pivot point labelled P, an arrow labelled F at the left end pointing upwards and an arrow labelled F at the right end pointing downwards, and distances labelled d from P to each end.

stem.text: Each force acts on the rod at a distance $d$ from the pivot P.
What is the torque of this couple about P?
